native.target: Exact current frozen Vexii native CPU model; reduced-FMA behavior is included.

host.sanitizers: ASan+UBSan; leak detector disabled because ptrace cannot support LSan and helper performs no allocation
host.checks_scope: Packet bounds/format, clipping capacity, callback cancellation at every selected output prefix, malformed-input zero emission, caller rounding mode/exception preservation.

reference.clip_cull_projection_quantization_packin: Mechanically extracted unchanged baseline functions, compiled with original fast-math flags. Source hashes and extracted fragment hashes are in native-v7/reference.json.
reference.scalar_raw_failure: Original executable instruction DAG, independently assembled after discovering that a reduced fast-math source extraction changes compiler reassociation/NaN comparisons. All scene rows additionally match the separately captured actual raw results.
reference.material: Uniform controlled textured/untextured, shaded/constant RGB565, tile bias/origin/alpha/projection cases. These vectors do not establish real shader setup or texture ownership.

correctness_details: UV transform preserves fused (value-origin)*0.03125+bias, including clipped fractional UV.
W admission preserves the original executable FLE rejection guards, including unordered W behavior; equal W uses the direct packet path.
Clipped fan order, six-plane strict-inside tests, interpolated color truncation and direct perspective scale match the reference.
No renderer globals, heap allocation, SDK ring calls or mutable material lookups exist in the helper. Only the supplied emit callback owns output progress.
Caller must couple cancellation with consumer/output reset; it must not send END after a cancelled partial packet.
App supplies immutable original source bytes/context for raw failure, and a complete current raw snapshot otherwise; raw/context lifetime belongs to the worker.
remaining_gates: Same-ELF complete native CPU+geometry+raster interval correctness and elapsed cycles.
Physical area/timing only if measured full-frame benefit warrants it; no claim here.
